race.comment: AUBAINE (1) just missed last time when a long neck away in second on the Pakenham Syntho over 1400m. Should be hitting his straps third-up on the quick turnaround and is ready to get off the mark. EXPENSIVE TASTE (12) has been freshened with 44 days after finishing midfield in the G3 SA Sires' Produce Stakes at Morphettville Parks. Has been kept ticking over with a recent trial at Flemington. Well placed and is expected to feature. LIQUID ASSET (10) has only managed midfield finishes in his first two starts but will be further improved and get a key booking in Allen from a tricky draw. In the mix third-up. NEVILLE BARTOS (4) wasn't far away when resuming here earlier this month and is another likely improver.
